summary.text: Alfred Reynolds is the Democratic candidate for the Florida State Senate, District 12, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An adjunct professor and U.S. Army Reserve veteran, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he teaches law studies in the Polk County School District.

paragraphs.text: Reynolds's Ballotpedia profile lists a bachelor's degree from Western Connecticut State University in 2000, a graduate degree from Laval University in 2007 and another from Liberty University in 2013, along with U.S. Army Reserve service from 1994 to 2010.
In the survey, he said he left his hometown in 1993, settled in Bridgeport, Connecticut, and joined the Army Reserve two years later.

Reynolds said he later began a law enforcement career in Georgia, including as a juvenile correctional officer, a National Crime Information Center technician with the Gwinnett County Police Department and an intensive juvenile probation officer with the Gwinnett County Magistrate Court.
He also said he holds an Ed.S. in Education Leadership and Policy from the University of Georgia, earned in 2019.
